description: Dev/prod notes-root split (M3 CRITICAL): 3 independent copies by design. AGENTS.md 'Named mistakes' explicitly accepts this as a non-goal for unification — registered so it's visible, not to be locked or collapsed.
note: Deliberately accepted duplication (M3 CRITICAL guard) per AGENTS.md 'Named mistakes' non-goals — do not attempt to unify or lock this; it is registered so the drift registry documents ALL permitted duplicates, including the ones that stay prose-only. The Android guard lives in storage/NotesStorage.kt's `deviceFolderName`, and its split works differently: DEVICE mode uses 'FUTO Notes Dev' vs 'FUTO Notes', while APP/INTERNAL modes already isolate through the `.dev` applicationId on package-scoped paths.
